name: SASHAToken
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the DeFiHackLabs root-cause title.

descriptions.text: The SASHA token contract and its associated Uniswap V2 and V3 pools were vulnerable to price manipulation due to insufficient liquidity and lack of slippage protection. The attacker used a small initial deposit (0.07 ETH) to swap for SASHA tokens via Uniswap V2, then transferred 1,000,000,000,000,000,000 SASHA tokens to the Uniswap V2 pool (UniswapV2_SASHA21), artificially inflating the pool's SASHA balance. This manipulation enabled a subsequent swap of 99,000,000,000,000,000,000,000 SASHA tokens for 249.276 ETH via Uniswap V3, exploiting the skewed price caused by the pool imbalance. The contract's lack of anti-manipulation mechanisms or transfer restrictions allowed the attacker to drain significant ETH from the pool, resulting in a profit of ~249 ETH.
